reviews.text: Dr. Orefice and her staff have always been a guarantee. They've cared for my family's mixed-breed daughter for over 15 years and now they're taking care of our newest addition with unparalleled attention and professionalism. I'm fortunate to live close to the practice, but I know clients who travel from far away just for her! Highly recommended.

I'm giving it one star because 0 isn't possible. I took my dog ​​to get washed. The groomer needed to be fired and put to work in a factory, not with animals. The dog came in fine and left short of breath, with a tachycardia, and other symptoms. Over the days, the dog got worse. He wasn't eating, was vomiting, and was hypothermic. I took him to the vet, who checked his pulse but didn't tell me he had 30 beats per minute, and when taking his temperature, she didn't tell me he had 36.1. Basically, I should have rushed to the clinic, but the vet ignored it, postponing the blood tests until Monday. The dog would never have made it to Monday alive. Something happened while they were washing him. But they don't want to disclose it. I strongly advise against it. Be careful for your pets.
They're better than everyone!!! Forever!
Dr. Maddalena saved my dog, I owe her everything. Professional and with a big heart. Thank you 🫶🏻 …

Good morning, I'm a regular customer at this store. The entire staff is efficient, polite, and helpful. Whenever my dog ​​has needed treatment or therapy, Dr. Orefice, with all her kindness, has always managed to resolve his issues. I also buy the right food for my dog's diet here, thanks to Nicola's advice, which you'll find behind the register. I highly recommend them to all animal lovers.

I thank the doctor and all the staff for taking care of my beloved Scarli for three years now.
I highly recommend them; the doctors are empathetic and sensitive, and the staff is kind and competent!
See you soon!

I took Fiocco, my Maltese, to this clinic and couldn't be more satisfied. From the first moment, there was an atmosphere of sincere love for animals.
Dr. Orefice was incredibly patient, explaining every detail of the treatment with extreme kindness. She's not only a competent doctor, but a warm-hearted person who knows how to put both animals and anxious owners at ease. The shop is well-stocked and, most importantly, affordable. Mr. Nicola accommodated my needs to the fullest extent possible.
I highly recommend!

They also offer grooming and a veterinary clinic, and Dr. Maddalena is incredibly skilled: attentive to the animals' needs, kind and caring, as if they were her own. She told us we didn't have to do anything else after the vial, but in reality we needed to buy ear mite drops! Then I went to another vet, also in Secondigliano, who gave my cat a vial suitable for her and cleared so many mites out of her ears that you wouldn't believe😊. Maddalena Orefice is not a professional, I don't recommend her. Please keep your kittens' health safe🙏🏼
